avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4/2D6 and increases serotonergic activity; risk of serotonin syndrome and reduced desvenlafaxine efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before initiating or after discontinuing desvenlafaxine

avoid_supplements.name: Serotonergic supplements (5-HTP, L-tryptophan)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects increase risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently with desvenlafaxine

avoid_supplements.name: Tramadol
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Combined serotonergic activity and shared CYP2D6 metabolism; significant serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; if pain management necessary, use alternative analgesics with lower serotonergic potential

avoid_supplements.name: MAOIs and MAOI-like agents (linezolid, methylene blue)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Severe risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis
avoid_supplements.action: Absolute contraindication; maintain minimum 14-day washout between discontinuation and MAOI initiation

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate serotonergic effects and stimulant properties; mild risk of increased serotonergic activity
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive stimulation, agitation, or anxiety; use with caution and inform provider

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Minor serotonergic properties; may have mild additive effects
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe but monitor for serotonin-related symptoms; use moderate doses

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet effects; desvenlafaxine may slightly increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bruising or bleeding; high doses warrant caution

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Desvenlafaxine may potentiate norepinephrine activity; tyramine can trigger hypertensive response at higher doses
avoid_foods.action: Avoid excessive consumption of aged cheeses, cured/processed meats, fermented soy products; monitor blood pressure if consumed

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive stimulant effects; may increase anxiety, tremor, or insomnia
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine intake; monitor tolerance and reduce if CNS stimulation occurs

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Increased CNS depression and impaired judgment; may worsen depression or anxiety
caution_foods.action: Minimize or avoid alcohol consumption; counsel on increased sedation and impaired cognition risk

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity, hyperthermia) especially with concurrent serotonergic agents. Assess for hypertensive episodes in patients with uncontrolled blood pressure or those consuming excessive tyramine; baseline and periodic blood pressure monitoring recommended.
